regions.shortDescription: A single cell drawn as a large green oval filling the left half of the slide.
regions.plainLanguage: This green oval stands for one whole cell.

regions.shortDescription: Six lines of introduction text in the upper right.
regions.plainLanguage: The text at the top right introduces the membrane.

regions.shortDescription: A teal block in the lower right representing the cell membrane.
regions.plainLanguage: The block at the bottom right is the membrane, the cell's outer layer.

regions.shortDescription: A wide rust-colored band across the upper half representing a mitochondrion.
regions.plainLanguage: The wide band near the top is the mitochondrion, which powers the cell.

regions.shortDescription: A large navy oval across the lower half representing the nucleus.
regions.plainLanguage: The big dark oval at the bottom is the nucleus.

regions.shortDescription: A smaller gold oval inside the nucleus representing the nucleolus.
regions.plainLanguage: The small gold oval inside is the nucleolus.

regions.shortDescription: Five lines of text in the upper left.
regions.plainLanguage: The text in the upper left explains ribosomes.

regions.shortDescription: A gold block in the upper right representing a cluster of ribosomes.
regions.plainLanguage: The gold block at the top right stands for ribosomes.

regions.shortDescription: A wide plum block across the lower middle representing the endoplasmic reticulum.
regions.plainLanguage: The wide shape at the bottom is the endoplasmic reticulum.

regions.shortDescription: A navy block in the upper middle holding the key idea.
regions.plainLanguage: The dark block near the top marks the main idea.

regions.shortDescription: Six lines of summary text in the lower left.
regions.plainLanguage: The text at the bottom left sums up the lesson.

regions.shortDescription: A green block in the lower right holding the takeaway.
regions.plainLanguage: The green block at the bottom right is the takeaway.

regions.shortDescription: A navy block in the upper middle representing a transport diagram.
regions.plainLanguage: The dark block near the top is the transport diagram.

regions.shortDescription: Five lines of notes in the upper right.
regions.plainLanguage: The notes at the top right explain the diagram.

regions.shortDescription: A navy block in the upper middle representing a transport diagram; this slide adds a slide-number box in the corner.
regions.plainLanguage: The dark block near the top is the transport diagram.

regions.shortDescription: Five lines of notes in the upper right.
regions.plainLanguage: The notes at the top right explain the diagram.
